FROM (
  SELECT zeitpunkt, 
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY zeitpunkt) -

    SELECT zeitpunkt, 
           CASE WHEN mwh = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS zero_streak
    FROM erzeugung
    WHERE energietraeger = 'Photovoltaik'
  ) subquery
) streaks
WHERE zero_streak = 1;
